title: Edison's device to communicate with the dead
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Edison's device to communicate with the dead, about 1920s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Edison, near the end of his life, actually tried to build a device to communicate with the dead.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Thomas Edison, the famous American inventor, tried near the end of his life in the 1920s to build a machine for talking with the dead. Michels tells it to show that serious inventors were drawn to the idea of reaching other realms through technology.
